changes.text: Character creation now survives a crash: if the game crashes, times out or your PC shuts down before you save, you continue editing from where you left off the next time you join
Eye colors are now shown as images instead of a plain list
Skin tone now has a Second Color and a Blend option
Body blemishes have been added to the Skin tab as their own category
The fade no longer disappears when you change your hairstyle
The fade can now be removed again
A problem with hairstyles has been fixed
Several problems with CTRL+Z have been fixed
Saved outfits can now be deleted
